result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-lane intersection in a residential area that lacks fundamental pedestrian safety infrastructure. There are no marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, or refuge islands, forcing pedestrians to cross a significant distance unprotected.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The roadway is exceptionally wide with no mid-block refuge, increasing pedestrian exposure to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the intersection across the main roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: Despite being a signalized intersection for vehicles, there are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian signal heads.

hazards.description: Parked vehicles and large vans near the intersection corners may block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection near the white van

result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-lane arterial roadway with a significant grassy median but a complete lack of visible pedestrian crossing infrastructure. While sidewalks are present in the distance, the immediate intersection lacks marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and curb ramps, creating a hostile environment for walking.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: No painted markings are visible to guide pedestrians or alert drivers to potential crossing locations at this large intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main boulevard and the intersecting side street.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: The extreme width of the multi-lane roadway increases pedestrian exposure time to high-speed vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Absence of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: There are no dedicated signal heads for pedestrians, leaving them to rely on vehicle signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian paths and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers and push buttons to provide safe crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions (bulb-outs) to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.
